issue.title: Notification tab priority-mark tests fail only in full selected lane
issue.description: During unrelated Artifacts query-history verification, just check selected a 7,238-node ACE-heavy lane and failed six notification tab-order/priority-mark tests. The local diff does not touch notification modal/tag strip code, and the same six nodes pass immediately in isolation. The failures all show Beads priority/lowered-tab state not matching expected ordering or missing the down marker, so they likely share one order-dependent/global-state cause.

task_type_fields.evidence: just check failed tests/test_notification_modal_mark_and_tabs.py::test_panel_and_hyphenated_tag_labels_are_humanized, tests/test_notification_modal_tab_order.py::test_declared_panels_sort_after_hitl_and_before_other_tabs, and four tests/test_notification_modal_tag_strip.py nodes in the 7,238-node selected lane; immediate focused rerun of all six nodes passed: 6 passed in 17.67s.
